name: The Colors of a Lost Sea
description:
Fen asks you to draw the coral before gathering it. Some records should be beautiful.

Use the Exotic Eye recipe in JEI; it combines an Eye of Ender, a conduit, coral, and glow ink. Earn End Remastered's exotic eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
